topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't believe it. Of all the teachers in this school, my child ends up with Mr. Thompson. The same Mr. Thompson who made my middle school years a living nightmare. I vividly recall the way he overlooked my questions, how he seemed to favor certain students, and the countless afternoons I spent trying to understand the lessons he rushed through. Now my child has to endure that? There's no way I'm letting this slide. I need to find out exactly how this happened and what can be done to make sure history doesn't repeat itself.
